mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Check whether an ABAP Unit test run has finished.

description: [read-only] Reads the status of the ABAP Unit test run named by run_id. Required: run_id*. Optional: with_long_polling. Response: JSON. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

with_long_polling.description: Use long polling while waiting for completion.

name: HandlerUnitTestStatus
